title: AI Price Index price record
description: One dated, first-party-sourced price assertion. This is the human-facing / contribution form. On ingestion the system of record adds the bitemporal bookkeeping fields (record_id, recorded_at, superseded_at, supersedes_id, change_reason, recorded_by); contributors and examples never set those.

model_id.description: Canonical model id, preferably the dated snapshot id, e.g. 'claude-opus-4-5-20251101'.

price_usd.description: Price in USD for one unit. A garbage filter only; real bounds are per provider.

effective_from.description: Valid-time start (inclusive): the date this price took effect in the real world.

effective_to.description: Valid-time end (exclusive); null means still current.

last_validated_at.description: When this price was last CONFIRMED against its source. For a backfilled record, the evidence date (a Wayback capture date). Required on every record, including historical ones.

source_url.description: First-party provider pricing page, or an archive link for a backfilled record.

source_snapshot_ts.description: Wayback capture stamp, e.g. '20250427064348'. Omit for live records.

confidence.description: verified = confirmed against the live first-party page; archived = a dated archive capture; inferred = derived from a changelog/announcement; estimated = best effort, clearly labelled.

notes.description: Optional human note (a caveat, a tier condition).
